## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game (status stays `unverified` — no in-game measurement exists for either the SS13 rework or the Condensed quartet). SS12 data is still selectable in the app and its compulsory-conversion model remains live and correct; nothing here invalidates it. SS13 mechanics summarized above are confirmed byte-for-byte against `data/seasons/SS13/_skills.json` (Chromatic Shot :22117-22126; Condensed Fire :22872-22896, Cold :22582-22600, Lightning :23023-23041, Erosion :22721-22745) by review-accuracy on 2026-07-16 — that verifies the DATA/CODE mapping, not in-game truth. The 1778.77 / 3779.88 / 2112.29 / 2534.75 DPS figures cited above are ENGINE outputs from `.wolf/buglog.json` id `chromatic-shot-shots-on-target-cap-coupled-to-compulsory-elements`, confirming internal consistency (fix vs. regression), not in-game readings.

## Implementation (engine model)

SEASON-DEPENDENT, no `if season ==` branch — `_resolve_chromatic_shot` reads each season's own data. `damage_types` is always derived from the skill's own `skill_tags`. `compulsory_elements` mirrors `damage_types` ONLY when the skill's own `raw_text` still contains the "forcibly converting the damage of the next use of this skill to that type" line (`_CHROMATIC_FORCED_CONVERT_RE`); empty otherwise. SS12: that line is present (`skill_tags` include Cold/Fire/Lightning, base 592-1100 Spell Damage) so `compulsory_elements` is populated and the resolver treats it as a true compulsory-conversion spell — each cast deals ONE listed element, all added flat (any type) folds into `base_flat_by_level` first, then only the chosen element's increased/additional apply; offense computes each element fully and reports the expected average. SS13 ("Afterlight"): the forced-convert line was deleted upstream, `skill_tags` became `[Spell, Projectile, Area, Physical, Horizontal]`, base became 529-881 Spell Physical Damage; `compulsory_elements` is empty and the skill resolves as an ordinary single-type Physical spell (`base_dmg_by_level`), no per-element split. Engine-measured (not in-game) SS13 max-level output: 529-881 Spell Physical Damage, `total_dps` 1778.77, `compulsory_breakdown` {}. Shotgun hit count comes from `chromatic_shots_on_target_flat`, surfaced via the `chromatic_shots_on_target` condition (default = all fired projectiles land; capped at the projectile count). This shots-on-target cap is now an explicit, season-independent `ResolvedSkill.shots_on_target_cap=True` delivery flag (added 2026-07-16) rather than being inferred from `compulsory_elements` truthiness — the two mechanics coincided in SS12 (compulsory AND shots-capped) but diverged in SS13 (not compulsory, still shots-capped), and the old proxy silently stopped applying the cap under SS13. See `.wolf/buglog.json` id `chromatic-shot-shots-on-target-cap-coupled-to-compulsory-elements` for the fix; engine-measured regression numbers (not in-game): SS13 with +6 Projectile Quantity and user override `chromatic_shots_on_target=4`, buggy `total_dps` 3779.88 vs correct 2112.29 (a 48.9% overstatement) after gating on the new flag; SS13 default (3 fired <= default cap 7) unaffected at 1778.77; SS12 identical scenario unchanged (2534.75, byte-identical before/after). Canvas supports (`skill_effects/chromatic_shot.py`): Lightchaser emits `projectile_speed_additional=0.30` (ADDITIONAL — the projectile-speed->damage path reads increased only, so ignored), `main_stat_dmg_bonus_inc=0.25`, homing that forces all shots on target, and a SIGNED tier-dependent `dmg_additional` roll. Splendor emits a `hit_dmg_additional` roll gated on `and` of `enemy_frostbitten`/`enemy_numbed`/`enemy_ignited`; its `preseed` auto-inflicts Frostbite + Ignite (100%) and Numbed (>=1 stack, user can zero out) — the fixed Cold->Fire->Lightning rotation is informational (same average). The universal +20% rides `support_resolver`. NEW (SS13 only) — the Condensed quartet, `chromatic_shot_condensed_{fire,cold,lightning,erosion}_noble`, 5th support slot only: replaces the deleted forced-random-conversion line with player choice. Each converts 100% of the supported skill's Physical Damage to its element by reusing the GENERAL conversion pool (`physical_convert_to_{elem}`, the same `offense._conversion_fracs` cascade a gear/talent conversion line drives — no bespoke conversion path) and grants the skill that element's Tag via the existing `add_mod_tags` override path (Split Shot's precedent), plus the universal +20% and a tunable +(23-25)% additional Hit Damage roll (`condensed_hit_dmg_contribution`). Every element/ailment name and number is parsed off the support's own text (`_parse_condensed`), never hardcoded per element. Ailment pairing (read from data): Fire->Ignite, Cold->Frostbite, Lightning->Numbed, Erosion->Wilt. Fire and Erosion carry a real chance roll (+40% Ignite/Wilt chance) plus "Adds 1-1 Base Ignite/Wilt Damage"; Cold and Lightning are DETERMINISTIC ("Inflicts Frostbite/Numbed when the supported skill deals Hit Cold/Lightning Damage", no chance roll, no base-damage line). All four preseed their enemy condition True by default (user can override). KNOWN GAP (owner-accepted 2026-07-16: "Its fine if they are tracked but contribute 0 dps, thats okay"): the Fire/Erosion base ailment damage stats (`ignite_dmg_flat_min/max`, `wilt_dmg_flat_min/max`) are emitted and tracked but contribute 0 DPS — no DoT-tick consumer reads them; `compute_dot` only reads a skill's own intrinsic `dot_forms_by_level`. This is a pre-existing engine-wide gap (no DoT consumer for support-granted base-ailment-damage anywhere), not specific to these supports — recorded here so it is not silently forgotten. `erosion` is newly reachable via Condensed, which the old SS12 random-elemental roll (fire/cold/lightning only) never offered.
